get.description: Returns recipient notification preferences, creating defaults if none exist.

put.description: Updates channel preferences and minimum priority for a recipient.

get.description: Returns a single diary entry by ID.

put.description: Updates the content of an existing diary entry.
A patient updates which views a caregiver can see.

404.description: Consent not found for current patient

get.description: Returns a health event and its associated reminder metadata.

put.description: Updates title, description, type, and schedule while preserving conflict validation.

400.description: Invalid event data or schedule conflict

delete.description: Deletes a health event and its associated reminder.

get.description: Returns notifications belonging exclusively to the authenticated session user.

post.description: Schedules or registers a notification for an authorized recipient and delivery channel.
Creates a reminder notification 24 hours before a health event.

400.description: Event is too close or request is invalid

post.description: Creates an escalation alert when a health event is not confirmed in time.

post.summary: Evaluate EXP-02 stepped alert schedule at current clock (US-03 / US-04)
post.description: Evaluates t0 common reminder (A and B), +15m reminder (EXP-02/B only), and +30m co-caregiver alert (EXP-02/B only with live consent check).

post.summary: Record observable notification preference or OS permission state (US-06)
post.description: Records NOTIFICATION_PREFERENCE_CHANGED (ENABLED, DISABLED, or UNKNOWN) while preserving Agenda access.
Records NOTIFICATION_DELIVERED only when channel delivery is acknowledged, without marking the medication event confirmed.

post.summary: Undo an accidental confirmation within 10 seconds (US-05)
post.description: Reverts a confirmed event back to PENDING within the 10-second grace window in EXP-01/B, preserving original MED_CONFIRMED history and broadcasting the reverted state.

post.summary: Record cross-session state observation for TSC verification (US-02)
post.description: Compares expected vs observed state on another authorized session using the server clock to compute TSC latency.

post.summary: Close a pending event with an explicit documented reason (US-07)
post.description: Records MED_RESOLVED_WITH_REASON identically in Control A and Variant B, resolving LRMR/TNR without incrementing TCOM.

post.summary: Confirm a scheduled event with server-side variant rules (US-01)
post.description: Audits MED_CONFIRMED idempotently, enforces 1000 ms press-and-hold in EXP-01/B, enables 10 s undo window, and broadcasts over SSE.

post.summary: Record explicit follow-up or telemetry loss (TS-02)
post.description: Marks a circle or scheduled event with an explicit loss cause so missing denominators are never silently dropped.

post.summary: Assign a care circle to an experimental variant (TS-02)
post.description: Locks a patient care circle to a single experiment and variant (EXP-01/A, EXP-01/B, EXP-02/A, EXP-02/B), freezes eligible MEDICATION schedules, and prevents cross-circle contamination.

get.description: Returns all medical document containers registered in the system.

post.description: Creates the patient-owned document aggregate used to store medical document items.
Registers metadata for a PDF, JPG, or PNG document up to 10 MB.
Uploads the file to private Supabase Storage and stores only metadata in the database.

get.description: Returns all diary entries ordered by entry date descending.

post.description: Creates a patient diary entry with non-empty content and automatic timestamp.

post.summary: Share patient profile with a caregiver
post.description: A patient grants or updates the views a caregiver can see. A caregiver can have only one shared patient profile.

400.description: Invalid request or caregiver already linked to another profile

post.description: Creates a patient or caregiver account with a unique email and strong password.
Revokes the provided bearer session for the current application instance.
Authenticates a user and returns a server-issued opaque bearer session that expires after 30 minutes.

get.description: Returns only the current patient's agenda or the caregiver's authorized shared agenda.

post.description: Registers a patient health event and creates a reminder 24 hours before the event when possible.

400.description: Invalid event data or schedule conflict

post.summary: Undo a confirmed health event within 10 seconds (US-05)
post.description: Reverts an accidental confirmation within the 10-second grace window in EXP-01/B without cancelling the event.

post.summary: Resolve a pending health event with an explicit reason (US-07)
post.description: Closes follow-up with a documented reason code without counting as a medication confirmation.

patch.description: Moves a scheduled notification to the sent state.
Marks a notification as read by its recipient.
Records observable channel delivery without marking the notification as read.
Cancels a scheduled notification that should not be delivered.

patch.summary: Mark all recipient notifications as read
patch.description: Marks all unread notifications for a recipient as read.
Marks an active alert as resolved.
Changes the event schedule and recalculates its reminder.
Marks a pending health event as confirmed, recording common experimental audit and SSE propagation when the circle is enrolled.
Marks a health event as cancelled without deleting its history.

get.description: Returns a notification by ID when authorized.
Returns notification history for a recipient when authorized.
Returns scheduled, sent, or delivered notifications not marked as read.
Returns unresolved alerts for an authorized recipient.

get.summary: Export reproducible circle metrics, audit trail, and Welch analysis (TS-02)
get.description: Computes TCOM, LRMR, TNR, UR, TSC, NOR per circle and Welch two-sample statistics for EXP-01 or EXP-02.

get.summary: Export circle-level experimental metrics as CSV (TS-02)
get.description: Returns per-circle reconciled metrics in CSV format for statistical verification.

get.summary: Get immutable audit trail for a health event (TS-02 / US-05)
get.description: Returns pseudonymized audit events ordered chronologically without clinical free text.

get.summary: Subscribe to authorized circle SSE state stream (TS-01)
get.description: Opens a Server-Sent Events stream for an authorized session. Consent and session validity are re-checked before every emission.

get.summary: Inspect dispatched sync messages for current session (TS-01 / US-02)
get.description: Returns state updates dispatched to the authenticated session's active subscription after live consent verification.

get.summary: Get server-resolved variant context for a circle (US-01 / TS-02)
get.description: Returns the immutable server-side experimental configuration so clients never self-select their group.
Returns the metadata of a specific uploaded document item.

delete.description: Removes an uploaded document item from a medical document container.

404.description: Medical document or document item not found

get.description: Returns a medical document container and its uploaded document items.

delete.description: Deletes a medical document container and all its document items.

get.description: Returns the medical document containers that belong to a patient.
Returns diary entries owned by a patient.
Returns profile sharing consents created by the current patient.
Returns the patient profile and visible views assigned to the current caregiver.

get.summary: Validate caregiver access to a view
get.description: Checks whether the current caregiver can see a specific patient view.

parameters.name: view
parameters.description: View that caregiver wants to open

404.description: Caregiver has no access to this patient

get.description: Validates a bearer token and optionally checks that the user has a required role.

parameters.name: role
parameters.description: Optional role required for the current operation

get.description: Returns the user represented by the provided bearer token.
Returns the calendar of health events owned by a patient.
Returns health events scheduled for a patient on a specific calendar date.

200.description: Patient health events for the date returned

delete.description: A patient removes a caregiver's access to their profile.

404.description: Consent not found for current patient
